name: Zone Sampler
description: Multi-sample instrument: many recordings mapped across the keys by note and by how hard you play, each key taking the nearest one and repitching it.

params.name: Tune
params.description: Transposes the whole instrument. Pitch and speed move together, so lower also plays each recording slower.

params.name: Fine
params.description: A small pitch offset on top of Tune, for matching the instrument to others.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a note takes to fade in. Short keeps each recording's own start; long turns it into a swell.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a note takes to fade out after the key is let go.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Low-pass filter on the whole instrument. Lower settings take the top off for a darker, softer sound.

params.name: Velocity
params.description: How much playing harder makes a note louder. At zero every note plays at full level; which recording a key picks still follows how hard it is played.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. Pushed hard, a soft clipper rounds off the peaks.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The voice path (Hermite read, power-holding loop crossfade, fade-out tail for a stolen voice) follows cpp/devices/sampler; the zones, the sample pool and the zone entry points are new.
